title: The sunlight on your skin is 100,000 years old
caption: The light hitting you left the Sun 8 minutes ago. The energy in it started the trip about 100,000 years earlier.
description: Light crosses from the Sun's surface to Earth in 8 minutes 19 seconds. Getting from the core to the surface takes far longer: energy is absorbed and re-emitted so many times on the way out that no single photon survives the climb. 100,000 years is a round figure under the published 170,000.
sources: Mitalas & Sills, "On the Photon Diffusion Time Scale for the Sun", ApJ 401, 759 (1992), doi:10.1086/172103
